layout: Single step screen. Light bg (#F8FAFC). Clean, professional feel. IDENTICAL LAYOUT to step 1, 3, 4 — only content area changes.

layout_structure.top_bar: Back arrow (top-left, active navy #003F8C). No skip link.
layout_structure.progress: Step indicator centered: 4 dot circles. Step 1: GREEN (#22C55E) filled. Step 2: ORANGE (#FF8A34) filled. Steps 3-4: gray (#E2E8F0) outlined.
layout_structure.illustration: Large briefcase/work icon centered, ~80px, in blue (#003F8C)
layout_structure.heading: 'Professional Info' — navy (#0B1B3B), h2 (24px), bold, centered
layout_structure.subtitle: 'Isi detail keahlian dan jadwal kamu' — slate (#64748B), body (16px), centered
layout_structure.cta: Button 'Lanjut' — orange (#FF8A34), full width. DISABLED until required fields valid.
layout_structure.spacing: 24px between sections. 16px horizontal padding mobile, 32px desktop.

elements: TOP BAR: Back arrow (ghost, navy #003F8C, active) left. No skip link.
PROGRESS: 4 horizontal dots. Dot 1: green (#22C55E) filled. Dot 2: orange (#FF8A34) filled. Dots 3-4: gray (#E2E8F0) outlined.
SUBTITLE: 'Isi detail keahlian dan jadwal kamu' centered, slate #64748B, 16px.

Multi-select tag chips, horizontal wrap: Strength Training, HIIT, Yoga, Calisthenics, CrossFit, Pilates, Functional Training, Mobility. Each chip: pill 999px, unselected bg #F1F5F9 text #64748B, selected bg #003F8C white text. Min 1 required.
Search input + 'Tambah' button. Added locations show as removable chips below with '×' remove. Max 3 locations.
PRICE PER SESSION: Label 'Harga per Session (Rp)'
Numeric input with 'Rp' prefix, placeholder '100000', step 10000. Min 50000.
Dropdown selector: '<1 jam', '<4 jam', '<24 jam'. Default '<4 jam'.
Toggle switch. Off: gray, On: orange (#FF8A34). Label: 'Tersedia untuk sesi online'
CTA: 'Lanjut' — orange (#FF8A34), full width. Disabled until min 1 specialization selected + price filled.
notes: IDENTICAL LAYOUT to other steps. Specialization is required (min 1). Price required. Online coaching optional. Gym location optional but encouraged.
